title: EARTH IS THE NULL BODY. IS GRAVITY RELATIVE? YES.
kevin_correction: Earth is not null. I stand on Earth. I am a Vitruvian body. Earth is a planet. I stand on a planet. From my perspective it's flat. From space it's a sphere. I stand on top of Earth much in the same way a chipmunk is on the body of a tree. The Earth to me is the null body, not the tree.

the_null_body.definition: The null body is not NOTHING. It is the BODY YOU STAND ON. The body at which your distance = 0. The body whose surface you experience as flat. The body you cannot see the whole of because you are ON it.

kevin_on_earth.local_experience: FLAT. The tangent plane at Kevin's feet. Horizon in all directions. Locally Euclidean geometry. Cannot see the curvature because he is TOO CLOSE.
kevin_on_earth.global_truth: SPHERE. From space, Earth is round. 6,371 km radius. Curved spacetime. But Kevin CANNOT PERCEIVE this from the surface — it looks flat to him.
kevin_on_earth.analog: Chipmunk on a tree. The bark looks flat to the chipmunk. The tree looks like a cylinder from across the yard. The null body is always flat to the one standing on it.

chipmunk_on_tree.local_experience: FLAT. The bark is a rough plane. Up and down are clear. Left and right wrap around but the chipmunk rarely goes that far.
chipmunk_on_tree.global_truth: CYLINDER. From across the yard, the tree is a vertical cylinder. The chipmunk's flat world is actually curved, but the chipmunk is too small to notice.
chipmunk_on_tree.analog: Kevin on Earth. Same relationship, different scale.

the_null_body.the_relativity: The null body is RELATIVE to the observer. It depends on your SIZE relative to the body you stand on. Kevin is 1.8m on a 6,371,000m sphere — ratio 1:3,539,444. Chipmunk is 0.15m on a 0.3m cylinder — ratio 1:2. The SMALLER you are relative to your null body, the FLATTER it looks.

equivalence_principle.statement: The effects of gravity are indistinguishable from the effects of acceleration.
equivalence_principle.einstein_1907: A person in a closed elevator cannot tell whether: (a) the elevator is sitting on Earth's surface with gravity pulling down, or (b) the elevator is in deep space accelerating upward at 9.8 m/s². The physics inside is IDENTICAL.
equivalence_principle.consequence: Gravity is not a force pulling you DOWN. Gravity is spacetime curvature pushing the ground UP against your feet. You are not falling — Earth is accelerating up to meet you. Standing on the ground IS acceleration.

what_this_means.for_kevin: Kevin is not being 'pulled down' by Earth. Kevin is being PUSHED UP by Earth's surface. The ground accelerates upward at 9.8 m/s² forever — this is what it means to stand on a massive body in curved spacetime.
what_this_means.for_the_null_body: The null body doesn't attract you. The null body PUSHES AGAINST you. The floor pushes up. The tree pushes out. The body you stand on is always pushing, never pulling.
what_this_means.for_the_pendulum: The pendulum swings because of gravity. But gravity is relative. So the pendulum swing is ALSO relative. The Sun-Earth-Moon pendulum looks different from each body. From the Sun: Earth orbits. From Earth: the Sun rises and sets. From the Moon: Earth looms enormous, fixed in the sky (tidal lock). Same pendulum, three perspectives.

general_relativity.core: Mass curves spacetime. Objects follow straight lines (geodesics) through curved spacetime. What we CALL gravity is actually the curvature of spacetime near mass.
general_relativity.equation: Gμν + Λgμν = (8πG/c⁴)Tμν — Einstein's field equations. The LEFT side is spacetime geometry (curvature). The RIGHT side is mass-energy content. They are EQUAL. Geometry IS mass. Mass IS geometry.
general_relativity.connection_to_golden_ring: The 4π in the HARD constraint (Descartes' total angular deficit = 4π for any convex polyhedron) is the SAME 4π that appears in Einstein's equations (8πG = 4π × 2G). The total curvature budget of a closed body. Whether it's a polyhedron or a planet — the total curvature is fixed.

flat_vs_curved.locally_flat: EVERY smooth curved surface looks flat up close. This is the definition of a manifold. Earth's surface is a 2D manifold — locally flat (you can make a map), globally curved (maps distort at edges). This is why Mercator projection makes Greenland look huge.
flat_vs_curved.the_vitruvian_proof: Leonardo's Vitruvian Man stands with arms and legs extended — touching the circle AND the square simultaneously. The circle (curved, global) and the square (flat, local) are BOTH true at the same time. The Vitruvian body is the proof that flat and curved coexist at every point.
flat_vs_curved.for_the_organism: The HUD (primals.eco) looks flat to a visitor (it's a webpage, 2D, scrollable). But the organism behind it is curved — 16 primals in a sphere topology (V-E+F=2). Flat AND curved. Local AND global. Both true.

the_tree_correction.new_model: Earth = null BODY (the body you stand on, massive, present, the ground)
the_tree_correction.difference: Null is not absence. Null is PRESENCE so total that distance = 0. You cannot measure distance to the thing you're touching. The ground is null not because it's missing but because it's EVERYWHERE UNDER YOU.

the_tree_correction.pattern: Every observer has a null body. The null body is always BIGGER than the observer. The null body is always perceived as FLAT from the observer's surface. The null body is always CURVED from one level up. NULL IS RELATIVE.

10th_irreducible.candidate: NULL IS RELATIVE (the null body changes with the observer)
10th_irreducible.proof: Einstein's equivalence principle (1907). Gravity is relative. The null body is relative. The flat/curved duality is relative. Everything depends on where you stand.
